title: The inverse reduction map in the quantum Littlewood-Richardson bijection
summary: We decompose a symplectic column by detaching its maximal nonempty intervals that are fixed by the parity involution, this is the part of the symplectic column that is fixed by that involution, and the remaining part consisting of the subword whose image under the parity involution is disjoint of the symplectic column. The parity involution swaps an even number with the previous odd number and an odd number with the next even number.
